item.title: The Indy Endorsement: The Honey Cake at Family Bakery
item.description: It consists of very thin layers of honey sponge cake, with each layer separated by a slightly tart cream filling. The predominant flavor is like a caramelized honey—but the cake is not actually all that sweet, and the texture is wonderfully soft without being at all mushy.
